reviews.text:
Great Application. This app is no mere tool… it is a digital grimoire whispering through the void.

From the moment you open it, the symbols feel alive ancient runes etched with the weight of forgotten gods and forbidden knowledge. Each draw feels less like a random selection and more like something… chosen. As if the abyss itself nudges your hand.

The interface is smooth and seductive, pulling you deeper into its ritual. Daily readings become addictive like a pact you didn’t realize you signed. The meanings are detailed and eerily accurate, echoing truths you may not be ready to face. Many rune apps offer simple guidance, but this one feels like it reveals things about fate, power, and the shadows within.

Grateful. This app, as well as its sister app, has been essential in my spiritual journey. It has helped me organize my thoughts and emotions, and understand life and reality in a humbling way, all through the runes.

My favorite runes app. EDIT: 2025-07-09

There is now a well functioning journal which unifies all saved readings across all spreads. Such a helpful feature.

I am very grateful for this app and the continued updates. I use it every day to cast the Runes.

Thank You!

- - -

The descriptions resonate with me and the app works smoothly.

What I think needs improvement is the save and recall feature for readings. It's a bit clumsy as it is right now, and would be a lot more efficient if there were a centralized journal where all readings are saved. Also, there seems to be no way to view the notes made when saving a reading.

Other than this, great app. Thanks!

Excellent!. I just want to say what an amazing job this app does! I feel very connected to the messages and I really enjoy the daily quotes and daily messages. I also really love the AI tarot and rune readings for spreads and specific questions. I’ve experienced a lot of accuracy. Great app!

Good app, recommended. I liked the app enough to buy the low priced extras. If runes and tarot are your thing, try out this app. It's nice to have the simple functionalities without the app trying to do "all the things". The one request I have is I want to be able to replace the standard tarot cards images with my own decks-the manner being as straightforward as I take photos of each card in a deck I physically own, then I swap out the defaults images manually. Thank you
Almost Perfect!. The ability to sync across devices would help a lot.

Suggestion to dev.. Great app very informative. 

Could you please add a feature so a user can input specific runes and Tarot in each of the layouts. Then enable the AI on these specific reading. This will definitely increase AI revenue and useful. 

Keep up the great work.
Love the idea. I love the idea and the information I just wish the app would work
My booger. ??
I purchased the full features immediately. I can tell you that this app is built with honor and respect for the old ways. I haven’t used it much yet but I can tell you that it’s absolutely worth it.

Yikes! Change it back please. The app was better before. It’s unusable now and I no longer resonate with it. Also it no longer functions properly and no one needs runes and tarot in 1 app. There are 1 million different tarot apps out there. If you want to be 1,000,001 just create a separate tarot app.
What you had before was light, easy to use, and reliable. After the update the app feels like bloatware. I will be deleting.
This app was fine. This app was great before the up date I used this app everyday for the daily rune .. and now I have to get use a different one

Too light to read. I cannot find Settings to change the font colors. Right now it’s white letters on a beige background and very hard to read. If I can’t get it in a darker font I’ll be uninstalling it

Great content, hard to see. I’ve been working with runes for decades, and find your app to be a useful tool. The rune definitions are true and easy to work with. I wonder why, however, the text is so small and white on a pale wood background. This app would be near impossible to use for anyone with poor near vision or any type of disability. I struggle and must put on my strongest reading glasses. It’d be great to have an interface upgrade that shows larger runes that look like actual stones, and text that is easier to read. I am also unable to use freestyle mode.

great app. so far this has been an amazing app that has been helping me learn runes. the meanings have been very accurate according to my more experienced friend and ive been getting better at learning the different runes and readings. however the freestyle option is not currently working for me which is a little upsetting.
